description: Project-authored soft motif associations from cited primary studies. Not an official CASMI dictionary. No absence penalties. Masses are singly charged ion m/z or neutral loss monoisotopic masses.

rules.caveat: Supports a phosphocholine motif, not a unique lipid class or structure. Does not distinguish PC from sphingomyelin. Sodium/potassium adducts are not included.
Positive evidence for a phosphoethanolamine headgroup; charge state and collision energy affect formation. Absence does not exclude this motif.
Supports a cleavable cyclic O-hexoside motif. Sugar identity and stereochemistry cannot be assigned. The conservative pattern omits furanoses and C-glycosides; missing loss never excludes them.
Supports an O-glucuronide-like motif without stereochemical specificity. Other conjugation types and rearrangements are not exhaustively modelled.
Supports a sulfate ester motif; SO3 loss alone is not a unique assignment. Does not cover every sulfur-containing conjugate.
